question: 男性用户最喜欢购买的商品是什么
gold_sql: select p.product_name from order_items oi join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id where u.gender = '男' AND o.status = '已完成' group by p.product_name order by sum(oi.quantity) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT p.product_name
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE u.gender = '男' AND o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1
